scope: scripts/qualify_library_compatibility.py, 56/56 steps, owned TIA V21 scratch projects: Bool-only, LInt/LWord/LTime and WString FB types authored and released 1.0.0 on a CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 and instantiated into an added CPU 1214C DC/DC/DC V4.7 and an added CPU 1511-1 PN V1.0 (6ES7 511-1AK00-0AB0, oldest catalog firmware). On V1.0 the Bool-only and 64-bit types apply and compile with 0 errors; the WString type is checkpointed and instantiated, then fails compilation (CompileFailed, 3 errors: Data type WString is unknown), completes no save, and a fresh reopen equals the saved inventory before the attempt. The S7-1200 and V13, unsaved-edit and uncompiled-type cases repeat local.library_compatibility.rerun.20261028.
limitations: Firmware is varied only within CPU 1511-1 PN (V4.1 to V1.0) and only for data types; firmware-gated instructions and other CPU types are not exercised.
A firmware mismatch is not refused at preparation; the mandatory compile catches it after the checkpoint.
The broken-generation type case of 27 October is no longer run: since 2 November a failed apply leaves the project recovery_required and blocks every later change.
